decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation builds on the firm's established laser coding expertise and in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the product, even though it is only mentioned on the website.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm's core inkjet coding knowledge, has its own web page, and fits the consumables-driven business model, so it is well positioned to be kept.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's existing printing technology portfolio, supports its strategy of matching technologies to each surface, and benefits from in-house development, making retention likely.
